profile.headline: Software Engineer at CYLITIX
profile.summary:
As a Computer Engineer in the software industry, I bring valuable experience in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Data Analysis, and the complete Software Engineering cycle. My time as a graduate student in Bioinformatics at Johns Hopkins University allowed me to apply my technical expertise to address complex challenges at the intersection of Computer Science and Genomics.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering from the Polytechnic University of Puerto Rico, and I am a dedicated engineering professional. My proficiency in collaboration, problem-solving, and communication has contributed to my track record of success in both academic and professional settings.

If you are interested in discussing the latest developments in NLP and Data Science or seeking collaboration and networking opportunities, please feel free to connect with me.

projects.title: Chat Bot
projects.description: Completely revamped an online tournament system from a public server with the development of a Chat Bot. It contains functions to automatically created and manage tournaments by its own with little to no human intervention. It also possess the ability to recognize images and the emotions implied on sentences. It is still currently being developed with more features to come, with Python and Artificial Neural Networks.

projects.title: Stock Predictor
projects.description: Developed a machine learning bot to predict stock prices of Bitcoin and Ethereum six months into the future with Artificial Neural Networks and XGBoost, using previous data collected from Deribit stock market. It accurately predicted the rise of prices over the summer season and was presented as part of a Capstone Design project at Polytechnic University of Puerto Rico.
